title: MetadataPackageVersion - Data API
description: Represents a package version (managed or unmanaged) that has been uploaded from the org you’re logged in to.

BuildNumber.description: The build number of the version. For example, if you upload two beta versions, they have build numbers 1 and 2. Then, when you upload a non-beta version, the build number is 3. When you upload a new version, the build number resets to 1.

IsDeprecated.description: Indicates whether the package version is deprecated. Available in API version 46.0 and later.

MajorVersion.description: The first number in a package version number. A version number either has an x.y format or an x.y.z format. The x represents the major version, y the minor version, and z the patch version.

MinorVersion.description: The second number in a package version number. A version number either has an x.y format or an x.y.z format. The x represents the major version, y the minor version, and z the patch version.

Name.description: The name of the package version.

PatchVersion.description: The third number in a package version number, if present. A version number either has an x.y format or an x.y.z format. The x represents the major version, y the minor version, and z the patch version.

ReleaseState.properties: Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
ReleaseState.description: If the package version is a beta version, the value is Beta. Otherwise, the value is Released.
